name: Chicken karahi
steps: Heat the oil in a wok (karahi) and fry the ginger-garlic paste for one minute.
Add the chicken and cook on high heat until the colour changes.
Add chopped tomatoes and the spice mix, cover and cook on medium heat until the oil separates.
Cook uncovered for a few minutes until the gravy is thick, then serve with roti.

name: Aloo palak (potato and spinach)
steps: Chop the onion and fry it in oil until golden, then add the ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomatoes and spices and cook until soft.
Add cubed potatoes with a little water and cook covered until nearly tender.
Add the chopped spinach and cook for five minutes until the water dries.

name: Sindhi chicken biryani
steps: Fry sliced onion in oil until brown, then add the chicken and ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomatoes, yogurt, spices and the potatoes and cook until the chicken is tender and the gravy is thick.
Boil the rice until three-quarters done and drain.
Layer rice over the chicken gravy, cover tightly and steam on low heat for 20 minutes.

name: Sindhi masala fish fry
steps: Mix the ginger-garlic paste and the spices into a thick coating and rub it on the fish.
Dust the fish lightly with flour.
Shallow fry in hot oil for four to five minutes each side until crisp and cooked through.
Serve with lemon, salad and roti.

name: Chapli kabab
steps: Mix the mince with chopped onion, tomato, spices, the egg and flour until well combined.
Rest the mixture for 15 minutes, then shape into flat round patties.
Shallow fry in hot oil for four minutes each side until crisp at the edges.
Serve hot with naan and yogurt.

name: Kabuli pulao
steps: Boil the beef with onion and spices until tender and keep the stock.
Fry thin carrot sticks in a little oil with the chopped dates until lightly caramelised.
Fry sliced onion until brown, add the soaked rice and the beef stock and cook until the water is absorbed.
Cover and steam on low heat for 20 minutes and top with the carrots and dates.

name: Daal tadka with rice
steps: Boil the washed daal until soft and mash lightly.
Boil the rice separately until fluffy.
Fry onion, ginger-garlic paste and tomato in oil with spices to make the tadka.
Pour the tadka over the daal and serve with the rice.

name: Aloo keema
steps: Fry chopped onion in oil until golden and add the ginger-garlic paste.
Add the mince and cook on high heat until it changes colour.
Add tomatoes and spices and cook until the oil separates.
Add cubed potatoes with a little water, cover and cook until the potatoes are tender.

name: Chana chaat
steps: Soak the chana overnight and boil until soft.
Let the chana cool, then mix with chopped onion, tomato and cucumber.
Season with the spice mix and serve cold.

name: Chicken chow mein
steps: Boil the noodles until just soft, drain and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry the chicken pieces with the ginger-garlic paste on high heat until cooked.
Add the shredded vegetables and stir-fry for two minutes so they stay crunchy.
Add the noodles and soy sauce and toss until everything is hot and coated.

name: Egg fried rice
steps: Boil the rice, spread it out and let it cool so the grains stay separate.
Scramble the eggs in a hot wok with a little oil and set aside.
Stir-fry the chopped vegetables for two minutes.
Add the rice, eggs and soy sauce and toss on high heat for three minutes.

name: Pasta arrabbiata
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water until just soft and drain.
Fry the onion and ginger-garlic paste in oil, add chopped tomatoes and the chilli spice mix.
Simmer the sauce for 15 minutes until thick.
Toss the pasta in the sauce and top with grated cheese.

name: Chicken pasta bake
steps: Boil the pasta until almost soft and cook the diced chicken in oil with spices.
Mix the pasta, chicken, chopped tomato and milk in a baking dish.
Cover with grated cheese.
Bake in a hot oven (200 °C) for 20 minutes until the top is golden.

name: Grilled chicken with potato wedges
steps: Mix the chicken with half the oil and spices and rest for 15 minutes.
Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss with the remaining oil and spices.
Grill or bake the chicken and potatoes at 200 °C for about 25 minutes, turning once.
Serve hot with salad.

name: Cheese omelette sandwich
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and cook as a thin omelette in the oil.
Sprinkle the cheese on the hot omelette and fold.
Layer the omelette and tomato slices between toasted bread and cut in halves.

name: Chicken and bean burrito wraps
steps: Boil the lobia and the rice separately until soft.
Cook the diced chicken with onion, capsicum and spices in oil.
Mix in the chopped tomato, rice and beans.
Fill each tortilla, add cheese, roll tightly and warm on a pan for two minutes.

name: Bean and cheese quesadilla
steps: Boil the lobia until soft and mash them roughly.
Spread the beans, chopped capsicum, onion and cheese over half of each tortilla and fold.
Cook in a little oil for two minutes each side until the cheese melts.

name: Hummus with bread
steps: Soak the chana overnight and boil until very soft.
Blend the chana with the oil, ginger-garlic paste, spices and peanut butter (used instead of tahini) and a little of the cooking water until smooth.
Serve with toasted bread.

name: Chicken kebab with rice
steps: Marinate the chicken pieces in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste and spices for at least 30 minutes.
Thread on skewers and grill or pan-cook, turning, until cooked through.
Boil the rice with the fried onion.
Serve the kebabs on the rice.

name: Grilled chicken salad
steps: Season the chicken with spices and cook it with the oil on a hot pan until done, then slice.
Chop the cucumber, tomato, cabbage and carrot.
Mix the yogurt with a pinch of spice as a dressing.
Top the vegetables with the chicken and dressing.

name: Vegetable daal soup
steps: Fry the onion lightly in the oil.
Add the washed daal, carrot, tomato and spices with plenty of water.
Cook until everything is soft, add the spinach for the last five minutes.
Blend lightly or leave chunky and serve hot.

name: Oats and banana bowl
steps: Heat the milk and cook the oats in it for five minutes, stirring.
Pour into bowls and top with sliced banana, chopped dates and peanuts.

name: Crispy chicken burger
steps: Cut the chicken into flat fillets and season with spices.
Dip in beaten egg, then coat in flour and spices.
Fry in hot oil for about five minutes until golden and cooked through.
Toast the buns, add cabbage, tomato, cheese and the chicken.

name: Chicken pizza
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, oil and warm water into a soft dough, knead and let it rise for 45 minutes.
Cook the tomatoes with spices into a thick sauce and cook the diced chicken separately.
Roll out the dough, spread the sauce and top with chicken, capsicum, onion and cheese.
Bake at 220 °C for 15 minutes until the cheese is golden.

name: Crispy fries
steps: Cut the potatoes into thin sticks, rinse and dry well.
Toss with the oil and spices.
Bake or air-fry at 200 °C for 25 minutes, turning once, until crisp.

name: Chicken paratha roll
steps: Knead the flour into dough and make thin parathas on a hot pan with a little oil.
Marinate the chicken in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste and spices, then cook until done.
Place chicken, sliced onion and tomato on each paratha and roll tightly.

name: Homemade chicken nuggets
steps: Mince the chicken with the spices and shape into small pieces.
Dip in beaten egg and then in flour mixed with bread crumbs (dried bread, crushed).
Fry in hot oil for four minutes until golden or bake until crisp.

name: Chicken shawarma wraps
steps: Marinate the sliced chicken in half the yogurt, ginger-garlic paste and spices for 30 minutes.
Cook the chicken in oil on a hot pan until browned.
Mix the remaining yogurt into a sauce.
Fill each tortilla with chicken, vegetables and sauce and roll tightly.

name: Aloo samosa
steps: Make a firm dough from the flour, a little oil and water and rest it for 20 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes and mix with chopped onion and spices.
Roll the dough, cut into half circles, form cones, fill and seal.
Fry in medium-hot oil until golden and crisp.

name: Soft burger buns
steps: Warm the milk and mix with the yeast and sugar and wait for it to foam.
Mix with the flour, butter and half the egg into a soft dough and knead for ten minutes.
Let it rise for an hour, shape into balls and rise again for 30 minutes.
Brush with the remaining egg and bake at 190 °C for 15 minutes.

name: Vanilla sponge cake
steps: Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Fold in the flour and baking powder with the milk.
Pour into a greased tin and bake at 180 °C for 35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

name: Chocolate cookies
steps: Cream the butter and sugar, then mix in the egg.
Add the flour, cocoa and baking powder and mix into a dough.
Shape into small balls, flatten on a tray and bake at 180 °C for 12 minutes.

name: Chocolate brownies
steps: Melt the butter and mix in the sugar and cocoa.
Beat in the eggs, then fold in the flour.
Pour into a lined tin and bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes. The centre should stay slightly soft.

name: Banana bread (whole wheat)
steps: Mash the bananas and mix with the sugar, oil and eggs.
Fold in the flour and baking powder.
Pour into a greased loaf tin and bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes.

name: Cheesy garlic bread
steps: Mix the soft butter with the ginger-garlic paste and spread on the bread.
Top with grated cheese.
Bake or toast at 200 °C for eight minutes until the cheese melts.

name: Gajar ka halwa
steps: Grate the carrots.
Cook the carrots with the milk on medium heat, stirring, until the milk dries.
Add the sugar and butter and stir for ten more minutes until glossy.

name: Atta halwa
steps: Roast the flour in the oil on low heat, stirring, until it turns golden brown and smells nutty.
Boil the sugar in water and pour in carefully, stirring.
Cook until it thickens and leaves the sides, then top with crushed peanuts.

name: Rice kheer
steps: Wash the rice and cook it in the milk on low heat, stirring often, until very soft and creamy.
Add the sugar and chopped dates and cook for ten more minutes.
Serve warm or chilled with crushed peanuts.

name: Zarda (sweet rice)
steps: Boil the rice until about three-quarters done and drain.
Make a sugar syrup and add the oil and chopped dates.
Layer the rice with the syrup, cover and steam on low heat for 15 minutes.

name: Date and peanut butter energy balls
steps: Blend the dates into a sticky paste.
Mix in the peanut butter and oats.
Roll into small balls and chill for 30 minutes.
